message: The called template '{0}' has a run-time type parameter. The type parameters of a called template must be marked with [CompileTime].
title: A called template cannot have run-time type parameters.
rationale: The message and title use the contraction 'can't' and lack an article, and the message gives no way forward although the fix is always to mark the type parameters with [CompileTime] (TemplateAnnotator.VisitInvocationExpression checks for type parameters whose scope is RunTimeOnly, including on overrides that omit the attribute).
